mapper.insert: MERGE diag_result_overview AS t USING ( SELECT #{row.tenantId} AS tenant_id, #{row.queryHash} AS query_hash, #{row.dataVersion} AS data_version ) AS s ON (t.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND t.query_hash = s.query_hash AND t.data_version = s.data_version) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET class_level = #{row.classLevel}, class_no = #{row.classNo}, class_name = #{row.className}, retail_type_id = #{row.retailTypeId}, dept_id = #{row.deptId}, business_circle_id = #{row.businessCircleId}, dept_group_id = #{row.deptGroupId}, store_no = #{row.storeNo}, period_start = #{row.periodStart}, period_end = #{row.periodEnd}, compare_start = #{row.compareStart}, compare_end = #{row.compareEnd}, metric_total_sales = #{row.metricTotalSales}, metric_total_profit = #{row.metricTotalProfit}, metric_profit_margin = #{row.metricProfitMargin}, metric_total_sku = #{row.metricTotalSku}, metric_active_sku = #{row.metricActiveSku}, metric_sales_rate = #{row.metricSalesRate}, snapshot_time = COALESCE(#{row.snapshotTime}, SYSUTCDATETIME()), update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( tenant_id, query_hash, class_level, class_no, class_name, retail_type_id, dept_id, business_circle_id, dept_group_id, store_no, period_start, period_end, compare_start, compare_end, metric_total_sales, metric_total_profit, metric_profit_margin, metric_total_sku, metric_active_sku, metric_sales_rate, data_version, snapshot_time ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.queryHash}, #{row.classLevel}, #{row.classNo}, #{row.className}, #{row.retailTypeId}, #{row.deptId}, #{row.businessCircleId}, #{row.deptGroupId}, #{row.storeNo}, #{row.periodStart}, #{row.periodEnd}, #{row.compareStart}, #{row.compareEnd}, #{row.metricTotalSales}, #{row.metricTotalProfit}, #{row.metricProfitMargin}, #{row.metricTotalSku}, #{row.metricActiveSku}, #{row.metricSalesRate}, #{row.dataVersion}, COALESCE(#{row.snapshotTime}, SYSUTCDATETIME()) );
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 id, tenant_id AS tenantId, query_hash AS queryHash, class_level AS classLevel, class_no AS classNo, class_name AS className, retail_type_id AS retailTypeId, dept_id AS deptId, business_circle_id AS businessCircleId, dept_group_id AS deptGroupId, store_no AS storeNo, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, metric_total_sales AS metricTotalSales, metric_total_profit AS metricTotalProfit, metric_profit_margin AS metricProfitMargin, metric_total_sku AS metricTotalSku, metric_active_sku AS metricActiveSku, metric_sales_rate AS metricSalesRate, data_version AS dataVersion, snapshot_time AS snapshotTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_result_overview WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND query_hash = #{queryHash} ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, id DESC
